semantics.authority: verified current caller/run/session/actor/tenant; no request-supplied identity
semantics.resolution: opaque purpose-bound reference for the exact current resource binding; not an invocation grant
semantics.discovery: trusted Agent initialize and tools/list/describe only; never tools/call
semantics.invocation: current durable grant/audit plus original argument bytes, approval value/presence and idempotency key
semantics.credential_expiry: minimum of 30s, resolution expiry, credential expiry and invocation grant expiry when applicable
semantics.secret_delivery: single Run memory only; no-store; never receipt/outbox/log/journal/cache/Web
semantics.opaque_references_and_arguments: SHA-256 of original bytes, not plaintext or parsed/reserialized JSON
semantics.unknown_or_mixed_input: reject before authorization or credential access
semantics.package_download: stdio Acquire requires a GET reference as erasable UTF-8 bytes, exact immutable package size and current Storage expiry; Resolve stays secret-free
semantics.package_download_binding: enclosing resolution_ref_sha256 binds runtime artifact, staging source version, ZIP digest and entrypoint; publisher/asset identity stays owner-only
semantics.package_download_expiry: material deadline is the minimum of resolution, credential, grant and Storage expiry; it does not revoke an already signed URL
semantics.activation: owner implementation + IAM fixed operation artifact + Agent fixed consumer + isolated chain acceptance required
